name: android-preferences
description: Drives the preferences example on an Android device or emulator and captures the presenter's own pixels. Requires the APK installed with inspection enabled and the port forwarded: adb shell setprop debug.poem.inspection 1, then adb forward tcp:47831 tcp:47831.
//: Toggling the checkbox exercises the DrawLine path: a checked box draws its tick as two diagonal segments, which is exactly the case the GLES presenter used to fill as a solid block. The captures make that visible rather than inferred.
//budgets: Android timings are recorded, not gated. There is no baseline for this scene yet, and a budget invented before a measurement is a guess with a threshold attached.
